name: Sign on to Meridian Core
description: Authenticate an operator against Meridian Core and confirm a session can be established. Returns no data by design: capabilities are stateless, so a session cannot be handed to a later invocation, and the verdict -- success, or a typed business outcome such as a bad credential -- is the whole answer.
goal: Sign on to the console as {operator} at branch {branch} and reach the main menu.

inputs.name: operator
inputs.description: Operator ID to sign on with (e.g. teller1, super1).

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: Operator password. Supplied at invocation and never persisted.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: Branch code to sign on against.
